framework_reason: PyTorch is not installed. Installing it would change numpy in the same environment the sarcasm detector uses. This BiLSTM uses the TensorFlow already installed.
stop_reason: Validation loss did not improve. Learning rate moves from 0.000250 to 0.000125. Early-stopping wait 3 of 3. Stop. Weights return to epoch 4.

split.fractions: FinancialPhraseBank keeps its original 70/15/15 split. SemEval headlines use their own 70/15/15 split.
